grammarFocus: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门。
title: The Lantern Maker's Story
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和题目都是模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。请根据短文内容选择或填写答案。
passage:
Last weekend, my friend and I were walking through the old town when we saw a small shop full of colourful lanterns. A sign above the door said 'Chen's Lanterns'. We went inside and met Mr. Chen, who was making a rabbit lantern at a wooden table. He smiled and said, 'Welcome! I'm happy to see young people here.'

Mr. Chen told us his story. He started making lanterns when he was twelve years old. His father, who was also a lantern maker, taught him everything. 'While other children were playing outside, I was learning to cut bamboo and paint paper,' he said. 'It was hard, but I loved it.'

We asked him about the Mid-Autumn Festival. He explained that it is a time when families come together and children carry lanterns in the streets. 'The rabbit lantern is my favourite,' he said. 'It is a symbol of good luck.' While he was talking, his grandson, who was about ten years old, came in and helped him. The boy was painting a small lantern with a brush.

Before we left, Mr. Chen gave us a red lantern. 'This is a gift for you,' he said. 'Remember, lanterns are not just for festivals. They bring light and happiness to every day.' We thanked him and promised to visit again. That afternoon, we learned that traditions are kept alive by people who love them.

grammar.title: 过去进行时与定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时间正在进行的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常与 when 或 while 连用：when 引导的从句常用一般过去时，表示突然发生的动作；while 引导的从句常用过去进行时，表示持续的动作。定语从句用来修饰名词，who 指人，which 指物，that 既可指人也可指物。
grammar.example: While he was talking, his grandson, who was about ten years old, came in and helped him.

options: While I was reading, the phone rang.
While I read, the phone was ringing.
While I was reading, the phone was ringing.
While I read, the phone rang.
answers: While I was reading, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while 引导的从句表示持续动作，用过去进行时 was reading；主句表示突然发生的动作，用一般过去时 rang。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The girl ___ is singing is my sister.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the girl 指人，定语从句中作主语，用 who。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the book 指物，定语从句中作宾语，用 which（或 that）。

options: When I was walking home, I saw a friend.
When I walked home, I was seeing a friend.
When I was walking home, I was seeing a friend.
When I walked home, I saw a friend.
answers: When I was walking home, I saw a friend.
questions.explanation: when 引导的从句表示正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 was walking；主句表示突然发生的动作，用一般过去时 saw。
